messages:
juan_support: Escalating EmberCo trial (acct: emberco-prod). Provisioning stuck - POST /v1/embeds returns 403 since 09:12 PST. Customer is high touch (ARR $120k), renewal ~28 days. Support tried rotate-key + reprovision, still 403. Opening handoff to CS. Ticket INC-6591. @laura_cs can you own comms? :eyes:
laura_cs: Thanks Juan - I can take it. Can you paste the latest logs and exact repro steps here? Any temporary workaround we can give the customer now?
matt_ps: Quick note: last week we saw a routing policy regression that caused scoped keys to be rejected when routed to regional-only pools. @anna_cs_manager might be related.
juan_support: Logs attached in INC-6591. Repro steps: 1) POST /v1/embeds with api_key ember-trial-xxxx -> 403 2) tried rotate-key via Console UI (Settings > API Keys) -> same 403. Short-term workaround: created scoped key with limited scope, embedding calls succeed but full ingest fails. Workaround noted in ticket.
matt_ps: If it's the regional routing issue I can attempt a manual flag flip for EmberCo's tenant. Patch ready (git rev 3f2a1c) - needs infra approval for canary.
laura_cs: Plan proposal: 1) Schedule 30-min call with the customer today to walk through workaround + confirm data recovery 2) Offer 14-day trial extension + 1:1 onboarding session if they accept 3) Keep renewal owner looped after fix. I'll draft comms once ETA confirmed.
anna_cs_manager: Sounds good. Laura - please include a comms template with apology + ETA + compensation offer. I'll join the call and own the renewal follow-up if needed.
juan_support: ENG estimate in ticket: 4-6 hours to flip routing flag and validate canary. Customer available for a 3:00 PM PST call today. I've updated INC-6591 with time.
matt_ps: Action item for infra: can we greenlight a targeted canary for emberco region tonight? If so I'll execute the flip and monitor. Rollback plan documented in INC-6591.
laura_cs: I'll send the calendar invite to EmberCo for 3:00 PM PST and include the temporary workaround + link to the support ticket. Draft comms (sending now):

Hi EmberCo team - apologies for the onboarding friction. We have a temporary workaround that allows embeddings while we validate a routing fix. We estimate a full resolution within 4-6 hours. We can extend your trial by 14 days and set up a 1:1 onboarding session. Joining call: @laura_cs, @anna_cs_manager, @juan_support.
Join link: https://zoom.redwood.com/emberco-esc
Ticket: INC-6591

laura_cs: Posting comms now. Will update with call notes and whether they accept the trial extension.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-6591 labeled "cs-handoff" and assigned to laura_cs.
anna_cs_manager: :thumbsup: Laura, please capture any product/UX feedback in the post-call NPS form so Product can track regressions.
juan_support: Customer confirmed 3:00 PM PST. Thanks everyone, will standby for canary go/no-go.
